payload.title: Creating LiPD files from a tabular template
payload.description: This workflow demonstrates how to programmatically create LiPD files from an Excel template using the PyLiPD library. It involves reading data from an Excel file, processing metadata, creating PaleoData and ChronData objects, adding an ensemble table, and saving the dataset as a LiPD file.

steps.description: Import the required classes from the PyLiPD library to handle various components of a LiPD dataset.
steps.title: Import necessary libraries and classes

steps.description: Open the Excel template file and read the necessary sheets into Pandas DataFrames. Extract metadata from the 'Metadata' sheet.
steps.title: Open and read the template file

steps.description: Create a PaleoData object and extract measurement data from the 'paleo1measurementTable1' sheet.
steps.title: Create PaleoData object

steps.description: Create a ChronData object and extract measurement data from the 'chron1measurementTable1' sheet.
steps.title: Create ChronData object

steps.description: Add an ensemble table from a CSV file to the dataset.
steps.title: Add ensemble table

steps.description: Write the dataset to a LiPD file using the LiPD class.
steps.title: Write LiPD file

steps.description: Re-open the created LiPD file to verify its contents.
steps.title: Open and verify LiPD file
